primary_title: Platelet-derived growth factor C (PDGF-C), a novel growth factor that binds to PDGF alpha and beta receptor
decision_basis: The reviews identify PDGF-CC as a ligand for alpha-containing PDGF receptors and cite the primary study showing high-affinity binding of the activated growth-factor domain to PDGFR-alpha homodimers.
